description: List open positions plus account value, free collateral and margin ratios. Use product_type=BINARY for Orderly Predict positions (positive quantity is UP, negative is DOWN). Position quantities can lag a moment after a fill; re-read before closing or sizing a new order.

network.description: Network override for this call. Defaults to ORDERLY_MCP_NETWORK, then the CLI config.

product_type.description: Filter by product type: PERP or BINARY One of: PERP, BINARY.
